Solidarity of Steel#000.src: Regroup with your friends outside {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#001.src: ...that's everyone, then. Good. Good, you're all safe. I wasn't certain, after...
Solidarity of Steel#001.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#002.src: Are you just going to ignore what happened back there?
Solidarity of Steel#002.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#004.src: Zhiraok's blessing... it gives him the power to revive himself. It takes some time, though.
Solidarity of Steel#004.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#005.src: If we wanted any chance to get away, I had to- I had to kill him.
Solidarity of Steel#005.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#006.src: Well, in any case, we're all here! We'll be meeting with my contact soon, after which we'll certainly be safe, but...
Solidarity of Steel#006.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#008.src: We have some time to spare. You've had a few days to acclimate to the Roughworks - any thoughts?
Solidarity of Steel#008.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#009.src: It is, isn't it? It's much busier, less open, and yet... it carries a certain nostalgia for me.
Solidarity of Steel#009.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#010.src: Nostalgic? This place, really? What's so nostalgic about loud factories and urban sprawl?
Solidarity of Steel#010.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#012.src: Well, I'm with Rex on th- this- this one! I wouldn't want to s- st- stay here for long, it's s- so... smoggy.
Solidarity of Steel#012.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#013.src: Certainly, it is not as... clean, I suppose, as the {p}. The smell of the morning dew shall be sorely missed!
Solidarity of Steel#013.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#014.src: Alright, children, get it out of your system. Please refrain from speaking poorly of the Roughworks once we meet with my contact... I'd like to make a good first impression.
Solidarity of Steel#014.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#015.src: Oh, you wouldn't think so if you actually had to live here.
Solidarity of Steel#015.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#017.src: What?! Most of them would agree with me!
Solidarity of Steel#017.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#018.src: I think I'm with Rex on this- this one! I can't im-imagine- imagine living here, it's s- so... smoggy.
Solidarity of Steel#018.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#019.src: Certainly, it is not as... clean, I suppose, as the {p}. The smell of the morning dew shall be sorely missed!
Solidarity of Steel#019.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#020.src: Alright, children, get it out of your system. Please refrain from speaking poorly of the Roughworks once we meet with my contact... no matter how much they may or may not agree.
Solidarity of Steel#020.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#021.src: In any case, I was told to meet them in the city at noon - {p} is usually empty during the daytime.
Solidarity of Steel#021.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#022.src: What? It's empty during the day? Th- that doesn't make a lot of sense.
Solidarity of Steel#022.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#023.src: I'm afraid the lives of the citizens of the Roughworks revolve entirely around their work. The work day starts at sunrise, and ends with sunset. So, let's just wait...
Solidarity of Steel#023.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#025.src: Maybe they, um, just read time differently, here...? Or maybe we-
Solidarity of Steel#025.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#027.src: Hello, Quill. It's been a while since we've met face to face, hasn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#027.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#028.src: Indeed, indeed... I hope your journey to cross to the Roughworks wasn't too difficult.
Solidarity of Steel#028.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#029.src: Could have been better, could have been worse. We expected difficulties going in.
Solidarity of Steel#029.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#030.src: I see... You'll have to tell me more later. Now, which of you is the cursed one? I'd like a look at you.
Solidarity of Steel#030.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#031.src: Mmhm! So you're the one, eh? What I'd heard in correspondence had me thinking you'd be different than us. Seems like I was right!
Solidarity of Steel#031.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#032.src: There's a look in your eyes, something to your gait. In all my years I've seen quite a lot, and everything that shouts "promise" is there in you.
Solidarity of Steel#032.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#033.src: Ha! Yes, yes, I suppose that would be the correct response to that question. You'd do well to stick to that script.
Solidarity of Steel#033.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#034.src: But Syndra has already written much about you in our correspondence. No need to be shy.
Solidarity of Steel#034.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#035.src: Blessed, cursed... They're two sides of the same coin, in my eyes. I've seen my fair share of both in my time leading this group, heh heh...
Solidarity of Steel#035.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#036.src: I see no reason not to celebrate differences, and what better difference could there be?
Solidarity of Steel#036.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#037.src: ... Ah, we'll have more time to speak later. We'd best make our way down to the station, we can sort out arrangements there-
Solidarity of Steel#037.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#038.src: Hey, hey! We're leaving before we even get our introductions in? Why'd we even come here then, man?
Solidarity of Steel#038.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#039.src: Yes, Yuman, why did we come here? You're the one who dragged us all along.
Solidarity of Steel#039.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#040.src: Well, hey, I just thought that this old man could use some help, that's all! Six people's a lot for one guy to greet, you know?
Solidarity of Steel#040.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#041.src: Yes, yes... Well, alright, since you all are here, we may as well handle introductions now.
Solidarity of Steel#041.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#042.src: I'm Yuman! I'm the greatest musician of our age, man! And I'm super muscular and cool, and-
Solidarity of Steel#042.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#043.src: Alright, Yuman, that's enough. I'm Yulie, oldest of three. I work as a detective in {p}.
Solidarity of Steel#043.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#044.src: Booooring! Come on, bro, have some-
Solidarity of Steel#044.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#045.src: And I'm Yusanu! I'm a mechanic. Quill's told us a lot about you, it's a pleasure to finally meet you.
Solidarity of Steel#045.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#046.src: Uh... S- same, I guess. This is all s- st- still a bit new.
Solidarity of Steel#046.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#047.src: Eh, you'll get used to it. This place has a way of growing on you.
Solidarity of Steel#047.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#048.src: Ah, if I may - I don't suppose you'd have anything prepared for us to be able to blend in better? I'd imagine we stick out a fair bit right now.
Solidarity of Steel#048.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#049.src: Hm... I hadn't quite considered that. Boys, why don't you handle that while Syndra and I go ahead to sort out living arrangements?
Solidarity of Steel#049.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#051.src: Leaves, why don't you join them? It'll be a good opportunity to get to know each other.
Solidarity of Steel#051.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#052.src: Um... I think I'd rather go with you. I'd like to rest a bit.
Solidarity of Steel#052.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#053.src: ... Then I'll tag along as well. Perhaps I could be of use at the station!
Solidarity of Steel#053.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#054.src: Very well. Follow me, we have an access point this way.
Solidarity of Steel#054.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#055.src: Well. I'm afraid I can't stay either... the station doesn't exactly run by itself. We'll have to catch up later!
Solidarity of Steel#055.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#056.src: Ugh, boring as usual... Oh well! Yulie and I can show you around just fine by ourselves.
Solidarity of Steel#056.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#057.src: We should start with getting you all some new clothes.
Solidarity of Steel#057.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#058.src: Hey! Wh- what's wrong with our cur- current ones!
Solidarity of Steel#058.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#059.src: They make you look like poor forest people, man!
Solidarity of Steel#059.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#060.src: Yuman! Don't be rude to our guests.
Solidarity of Steel#060.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#061.src: What, I'm just saying! Am I wrong?
Solidarity of Steel#061.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#062.src: Well! At l- lea- at least we don't smell bad!
Solidarity of Steel#062.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#063.src: Alright, boys, settle down, play nice. You're both pretty. So, Yulie, what's the plan?
Solidarity of Steel#063.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#064.src: I'll have to swing by some shops... Yuman, in the meantime, why don't you see if you can find any clothes around here?
Solidarity of Steel#064.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#065.src: Great, I'll join you. I need to get re-acquainted with things around here.
Solidarity of Steel#065.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#066.src: Sure, that works. Any complaints, Yuman?
Solidarity of Steel#066.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#067.src: If I had 'em, you'd hear it loud and clear. The plan's good, bro.
Solidarity of Steel#067.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#068.src: Okay, we'll meet back at the Steel Feather once we're done. See you then!
Solidarity of Steel#068.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#069.src: ...Well! I've got a plan of my own in mind. Not exactly what Yulie had in mind, but... heh, what he doesn't know won't hurt him. Follow me, leaf people!
Solidarity of Steel#069.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#070.src: Find clothes in the city by following Yuman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#071.src: Hey! Hold- h- hold up! What's your p- p- plan?
Solidarity of Steel#071.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#072.src: Oh! Right. We're going to steal from the clotheslines, of course.
Solidarity of Steel#072.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#073.src: ... I'm no stranger to st- stealing, but... isn't it a bit r- r-... a bit risky to do that in the m- middle of the city?
Solidarity of Steel#073.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#074.src: Man, haven't you noticed how empty {p} is?
Solidarity of Steel#074.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#075.src: Figures you wouldn't know, since you're not from around here! It's pretty simple.
Solidarity of Steel#075.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#076.src: It's the middle of the workday! People are out at their jobs, they don't have time to stroll around the city! Got to make a living somehow, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#076.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#077.src: A- and since they're out at their jobs, they're n- n- not home... you want us to just walk th- through someone's apartment, then?
Solidarity of Steel#077.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#078.src: Yep, yep, exaaaactly! You get it. I think you and I are gonna get along great.
Solidarity of Steel#078.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#079.src: Yeah... sure. L- let- let's get going! I think we can rea- reach the from this house. We'll find some clothes up there.
Solidarity of Steel#079.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#080.src: Ha! Really? You should... you should pay more attention, man. The moment you stop keeping an eye on things is the moment things go wrong, y'know? Jeez.
Solidarity of Steel#080.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#081.src: What I was gonna say is that it's the middle of the workday. People are out at their jobs! No time to stroll around the city, or anything.
Solidarity of Steel#081.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#082.src: A- and since they're out at their jobs, they're n- not home... you want us to just walk th- through someone's apartment, then?
Solidarity of Steel#082.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#083.src: Mhm, yep, you get it. They won't mind! Cause they won' know we were there, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#083.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#084.src: I- I- I guess. Okay, let's get going! I think we can rea- reach the from this house. We'll find some clothes up there.
Solidarity of Steel#084.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#085.src: Climb up the apartment at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and jump across the roofs.

Solidarity of Steel#086.src: Try n-not to fall off the roof...
Solidarity of Steel#086.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#087.src: Jump across the roofs to the first spot at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Solidarity of Steel#088.src: I'll be right be- behind you! Let's get up to the rooftops. I think we can rea- reach them through this building.
Solidarity of Steel#088.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#089.src: ...what the hell are you doin' jumpin' around?
Solidarity of Steel#089.speaker: Timaca Mason

Solidarity of Steel#090.src: Buzz off, some've us got jobs.
Solidarity of Steel#090.speaker: Timaca Mason

Solidarity of Steel#091.src: Here we are! Best clothes in the entire province, man! Take your pick!
Solidarity of Steel#091.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#092.src: ... Wait a mi- min- minute. There are only dr- dresses here?
Solidarity of Steel#092.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#093.src: Oh, yeah. My bad, man! Bet you could pull it off though, eh?
Solidarity of Steel#093.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#094.src: I- y- you- wh- wh- what- h- huh? Ev- even- even if I could, Rex and Mora would- w- would never wear- wear these. A- and- and they're n- n- not-
Solidarity of Steel#094.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#095.src: Relax, I'm just messing with you, man! We'll find some more. But, hey, grab one if you want, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#095.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#097.src: I'll take one for Sui, just in c- cas- just in case. And let's hurry after him. I'm getting sick a- and-... s- sick and tired of this place already.
Solidarity of Steel#097.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#098.src: Continue looking for clothes on the rooftops at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#099.src: It's g-going to be a long c- couple of days, huh?
Solidarity of Steel#099.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#100.src: Careful there, princess! Wouldn't want to fall, eh?
Solidarity of Steel#100.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#102.src: Anyway, these clothes should work, yeah? Looks like enough for all of you!
Solidarity of Steel#102.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#103.src: ...yes, this sh- sh- should be fine. Thank you f- for showing us. Let's just grab them a- and go.
Solidarity of Steel#103.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#104.src: Sounds good! You saw the big statue in the river when you were entering the city, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#104.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#105.src: The one to the s- south- , yes.
Solidarity of Steel#105.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#106.src: That's the one! I'll wait for you there, then we can head to the station. And hurry up, would ya?
Solidarity of Steel#106.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#107.src: Find the statue in the water at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#108.src: Ugh... How can one guy be s- s- so annoying?
Solidarity of Steel#108.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#109.src: Whatever... Let's just go to that s- st- statue. It's in the river t- to the southwest.
Solidarity of Steel#109.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#110.src: Ey, there you are! What's with the holdup?
Solidarity of Steel#110.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#111.src: I was just telling Zeph all about our base of operations! Here, I can start over if you-
Solidarity of Steel#111.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#112.src: Let's just h- head in! Even if the city's empty, the longer we stay out here, the more we ri- risk getting seen.
Solidarity of Steel#112.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#113.src: Yeah, yeah, you're right. Okay, follow me! It's just down here.
Solidarity of Steel#113.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#115.src: Sorry if our secret base isn't up to your high standards, princess! We've got to stay hidden somehow, eh?
Solidarity of Steel#115.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#117.src: Follow Yuman and Zeph into the sewer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#119.src: Catch up with Zeph and Rex.

Solidarity of Steel#121.src: Welcome to the station, man! There's a bunch of abandoned train lines down here. Dunno how we first found it, but it's where the Steel Feather operates.
Solidarity of Steel#121.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#123.src: Good to see you've made it down here too. Yuman, you weren't rude to our guests, were you?
Solidarity of Steel#123.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#124.src: What? Screw you, man, of course I was nice! When have I ever not been nice and kind and awesome?
Solidarity of Steel#124.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#125.src: Well, either way, I'm sure you've tired them out by now. Let's go on ahead and give them time to catch up, alright?
Solidarity of Steel#125.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#127.src: So... how've you been finding Yuman so far?
Solidarity of Steel#127.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#128.src: Ugh. He's f- fi- fine. We got the clothes, at least.
Solidarity of Steel#128.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#129.src: Hm. You don't sound fine. Spill.
Solidarity of Steel#129.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#130.src: Oh, that's it? He's just like that.
Solidarity of Steel#130.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#131.src: He's just... very p- per- persistent.
Solidarity of Steel#131.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#132.src: Well, that says more about you than it does about him. Have you tried making it less easy for him?
Solidarity of Steel#132.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#133.src: Ha ha. Very hel- hel- helpful, Rex.
Solidarity of Steel#133.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#134.src: Makes sense, I guess. It's been a few days since we've been able to relax, hasn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#134.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#135.src: Yeah... it'll be n- n- nice to slow down, for a while.
Solidarity of Steel#135.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#136.src: Not sure how long we'll be slowed down... but sure. I think Syndra's got some plans in the works, but she hasn't shared them yet.
Solidarity of Steel#136.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#137.src: She's been getting... more ambitious lately. {u}, I think having you around has had something to do with that.
Solidarity of Steel#137.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#138.src: We- we- well, how about you? Is the Roughworks just how you r- remember it?
Solidarity of Steel#138.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#139.src: Yeah... pretty much. Things don't tend to change a lot around here, so... it's just like slotting back into place.
Solidarity of Steel#139.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#141.src: Ha. No, it really isn't. The few months I spent here before Quill sent me off to Syndra were... rough.
Solidarity of Steel#141.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#142.src: Oh... h- how come? You've never really talked about the R- R- Rough-... about the R- Roughworks.
Solidarity of Steel#142.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#143.src: Uh... Hey, so about those clothes- let's take a look at what you got!
Solidarity of Steel#143.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#144.src: R- right... right! Well, here are th- the- the, uh, workers' clothes we got f- for me, Mora, and {u}... And this is a dr- dress for Sui...
Solidarity of Steel#144.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#145.src: And, of- of- of course, a simple dress for you!
Solidarity of Steel#145.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#146.src: Oh... that's funny, I don't think I've ever worn one of those! Hey, maybe I'll just take your set and you can wear the dress?
Solidarity of Steel#146.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#147.src: Woah, ha, we- well, let's not g- g- get too hasty, haha- oh, l- look here, an extra set of re- reg- regular workers' clothes! What a c- co- coincidence!
Solidarity of Steel#147.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#148.src: ...don't, uh, m- m- make me wear the dress, please?
Solidarity of Steel#148.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#149.src: Yeah, yeah. Well, that's enough fooling around - we should find Mora and Sui, see what they've figured out. I'll race you there!
Solidarity of Steel#149.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#150.src: Hey! Oh, you're going d- down!
Solidarity of Steel#150.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#154.src: Indeed! Tell us, friends, how go the escapades? Has anything of interest transpired up in the city?
Solidarity of Steel#154.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#155.src: No, Mora, nothing very exciting. Yulie and I did a quick supply run in {p} while we were there.
Solidarity of Steel#155.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#156.src: And {u} and I found some cl- cl- clothes! They might not fit perfectly, but...
Solidarity of Steel#156.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#157.src: Ah, well, we'll take what we can get. Besides, I have to imagine they have someone around here who knows their way around modifying clothes!
Solidarity of Steel#157.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#158.src: Speaking of, have you had time to explore this place yet? It's far larger than I could have anticipated! So many people with so many skillsets; Syndra wasn't lying when she said they had resources here, hoho!
Solidarity of Steel#158.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#159.src: Yes... everyone chips in, too. I got put to work quite fast. Had an opportunity to chat with some of the people here.
Solidarity of Steel#159.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#160.src: They, um... a lot of them don't have anywhere else to go... so they work hard to keep this place running.
Solidarity of Steel#160.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#162.src: Hey, do you know where Yusanu is? I haven't had the chance to catch up with him yet.
Solidarity of Steel#162.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#163.src: Oh, he seemed to have disappeared into his study some time ago, though not before I could have a chat with him! Did you know he singlehandedly repaired much of the abandoned infrastructure here?
Solidarity of Steel#163.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#165.src: Apparently, um, the crown was working on building this, central station, but they... abandoned the project, for, some reason. Nobody... really knows why.
Solidarity of Steel#165.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#166.src: Hm... so what are Syndra and Quill ta- talk- talking about over there?
Solidarity of Steel#166.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#167.src: An excellent question! Nobody knows! Attempting to interject has only resulted in failure thus far.
Solidarity of Steel#167.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#168.src: I mean... should we even interrupt? I haven't seen her this... happy... in a long time.
Solidarity of Steel#168.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#169.src: It is a sweet moment, isn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#169.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#171.src: Well, I nominate {u} to go interrupt them. It needs to be done eventually.
Solidarity of Steel#171.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#172.src: Oh, yes, I second that notion. If it must be anyone, {u} is the one to sacrifice for the cause.
Solidarity of Steel#172.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#173.src: Oh! Uh... sure, I'll... th- third it? That sounds right.
Solidarity of Steel#173.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#175.src: Well! Three for, one against. It seems the decision has been made!
Solidarity of Steel#175.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#176.src: Yeah, yeah! Come on, what are you waiting for? Go , and find out what they're talking about.
Solidarity of Steel#176.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#177.src: Good luck, my friend! You'll certainly need it.
Solidarity of Steel#177.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#178.src: Your sacrifice will not be in vain.
Solidarity of Steel#178.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#179.src: I had no p- pa- part in this!
Solidarity of Steel#179.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#180.src: Don't try to get out of this, Zeph. You're just as complicit in this as the rest of us.
Solidarity of Steel#180.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#181.src: Wh- I- fine... {u}, just get it o- over with. Go , and find out what th- they- wh- what they're talking about.
Solidarity of Steel#181.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#182.src: I will remember you fondly, my friend.
Solidarity of Steel#182.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#186.src: H-hey! Don't you have a m-mission to do?
Solidarity of Steel#186.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#187.src: Ah, {u}! I see you have all returned. Welcome to our home.
Solidarity of Steel#187.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#188.src: I hope the brothers weren't too much of a nuisance. Yuman, especially... he's a good lad, but he tends towards
Solidarity of Steel#188.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#189.src: Speaking of nuisances... I can't help but notice the rest of our group looking onwards at our conversation with excitement.
Solidarity of Steel#189.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#190.src: Ah! Understood. A noble one, at that.
Solidarity of Steel#190.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#191.src: In any case, Quill and I have been trying to plan out our next moves... but, if I'm being honest, most of that time has been spent catching up.
Solidarity of Steel#191.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#192.src: Don't be fooled. All of these people here are resisting to some extent, but very few are ready to go up against a God.
Solidarity of Steel#192.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#193.src: Hah! Goodness, how long has it been since we met face to face? It must have been... {~} years? Not since before you-
Solidarity of Steel#193.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#195.src: ...Ahem. Yes, of course. As Syndra said, we haven't truly started planning yet... You must be surprised by our numbers, yes? More members in the Steel Feather than you'd have expected.
Solidarity of Steel#195.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#196.src: In truth, looks may be deceiving. Everyone here is resisting in whatever ways they can manage, but few are willing to put as much of themselves into it as your group.
Solidarity of Steel#196.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#197.src: Most of them are simply trying to live without the watchful eye of the monarchy. Our safe haven takes in people who are at risk. People who can't work, who have been thrown out of their homes...
Solidarity of Steel#197.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#198.src: But we are not helpless. The brothers and I are all ready to help, however we can. And the rest of the Steel Feather will still offer support from the sidelines. We have infrastructure, and we have resources.
Solidarity of Steel#198.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#199.src: I've also suggested that you might offer to teach the basics of magic to those who are interested-
Solidarity of Steel#199.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#200.src: Yes, yes, but I do not believe we need curses or blessings to resist. As I've told you several times before in our correspondences, Syndra!
Solidarity of Steel#200.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#201.src: And as I've told you in response, I see no reason not to make use of all the tools available!
Solidarity of Steel#201.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#202.src: Syndra, I have been firm on this point for a reason. We have done well for ourselves thus far.
Solidarity of Steel#202.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#203.src: As an example- Yusanu has grown quite proficient with machinery. He has constructed weaponry, tools- even my leg is his creation!
Solidarity of Steel#203.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#204.src: ... I simply think that-... Sigh. Fine. Quill, we should get to discussing the reason we came here.
Solidarity of Steel#204.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#205.src: Yes, I rather think we should. {u}, in the meantime, why don't you take a look around the station? Familiarize yourself with the area and the people.
Solidarity of Steel#205.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#206.src: Explore the Steel Feather train station at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#207.src: Take a look around the station! Familiarize yourself with the area and the people.
Solidarity of Steel#207.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#208.src: Hoho! So they return! Tell us, how did it go?
Solidarity of Steel#208.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#210.src: Ah, we all knew the stakes going in! Worry not, friend, your sacrifice will not be forgotten any time soon!
Solidarity of Steel#210.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#211.src: Hey! E- e- enough with the theatrics!
Solidarity of Steel#211.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#212.src: Excellent! You have successfully defied the odds, friend!
Solidarity of Steel#212.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#213.src: Zeph didn't believe you'd make it, you know.
Solidarity of Steel#213.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#214.src: Wh- what, n- no I- I didn't- Sui!! D- don't- don't believe a word- a word she says, o- okay?
Solidarity of Steel#214.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#215.src: Wh- what were they talking about, anyway?
Solidarity of Steel#215.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#216.src: Oh, so it was as boring as I predicted.
Solidarity of Steel#216.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#217.src: Don't call that boring, Rex! It's... nice for her to relax for a little, isn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#217.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#218.src: It can be both boring and a nice thing, can it not? The nice things often tend towards the boring end of the spectrum, in any case.
Solidarity of Steel#218.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#219.src: So, still n- nothing about the plans... when is she go- go- going to tell us anything?
Solidarity of Steel#219.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#220.src: Have patience, young Leaf. She will tell us when it is time! Now, Sui and I have had the opportunity to explore, but you three have not! So, go on! Look around, talk to people.
Solidarity of Steel#220.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#222.src: Ah. You're all back already? Man, I totally lost track of time there... there's so much to do.
Solidarity of Steel#222.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#223.src: So, what's up? Sorry I couldn't talk to you more earlier- I'm the one who makes sure everything runs smoothly here.
Solidarity of Steel#223.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#224.src: Most of the infrastructure was here already, but I basically fixed it all up myself... with some help, of course. But now I'm in charge of maintaining all of it!
Solidarity of Steel#224.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#225.src: It's not usually this... hectic. We had some stuff break down recently, and I'm the oooonly one who can deal with it!
Solidarity of Steel#225.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#227.src: ... Still don't have time to chat, sorry! I'm nearly done, though, I'll be out in a bit.
Solidarity of Steel#227.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#230.src: Hah! Yeah, yeah, maybe. I was hoping to tease him some more.
Solidarity of Steel#230.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#231.src: He's a fun guy! But the boy's gotta learn how to tease back... it's no fun if it's one-side, y'know?
Solidarity of Steel#231.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#232.src: ...what? Ey, don't look at me like that! It's all for fun at the end of the day. If he tells me to quit it, I'll quit it.
Solidarity of Steel#232.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#234.src: I'll... go over there later. Eventually! ... Maybe.
Solidarity of Steel#234.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#235.src: Eheh. Wouldn't want to overstay my welcome, y'know? I've got things to do, anyway...
Solidarity of Steel#235.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#236.src: ...so, you exploring? That's good! I'd show you around, but... eheh, I'm uh, working on a little something right now.
Solidarity of Steel#236.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#237.src: Yo, quit trying to sneak a peak at it! No spoilers! You'll see it tonight, if I get it done.
Solidarity of Steel#237.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#239.src: Hm. I suppose you're used to invading personal space?
Solidarity of Steel#239.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#240.src: Don't worry, I'm not upset. I appreciate the effort in familiarizing yourself with this place.
Solidarity of Steel#240.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#241.src: Did you have a question, or are you just looking around?
Solidarity of Steel#241.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#242.src: Oh, has he done something again? Of course he has... I apologize for my brother's actions.
Solidarity of Steel#242.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#243.src: He's... hard to keep a handle on. Energetic, impulsive... I do love him, but do I ever wish he would cause less trouble.
Solidarity of Steel#243.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#245.src: Ah. Then I apologize for my assumption.
Solidarity of Steel#245.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#246.src: He's... I might be too hard on him sometimes. He does help out a lot around here, he does- just... like I said. Energetic and impulsive.
Solidarity of Steel#246.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#247.src: You'll get used to his personality, with time. Everyone does.
Solidarity of Steel#247.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#248.src: But in any case, I'll speak with him about it. He should know better than to bother our guests.
Solidarity of Steel#248.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#249.src: I have to get back to work. I'll see you around.
Solidarity of Steel#249.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#250.src: Hm? My role? That's a bit of a complex question, actually. In the Steel Feather... I don't do much.
Solidarity of Steel#250.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#251.src: But I work as a consulting detective for the crown, in the city. I perform investigations for them, but I also gather information for us - keeping tabs on the military, and such.
Solidarity of Steel#251.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#252.src: Besides, the pay's... decent enough. A few emeralds in my pocket helps all of us down here. Unfortunately, we can't produce everything ourselves.
Solidarity of Steel#252.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#253.src: But speaking of my work, I... am actually busy preparing for a meeting right now. {p}'s Commander wants us on the lookout for... something, he hasn't told us yet.
Solidarity of Steel#253.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#254.src: But it's my duty to find out, so into the city I will go. If you'll excuse me, I'll get back to preparing now.
Solidarity of Steel#254.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#255.src: Return to the main room at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#257.src: Nothing beyond what I'd written in our letters.
Solidarity of Steel#257.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#258.src: Alright... thank you, Quill. Just a little longer, then I-
Solidarity of Steel#258.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#259.src: Ah, {u}! What do you think of our home? It took a great deal of planning to get the station up and running, but I feel we've done a good-
Solidarity of Steel#259.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#262.src: I overheard... an altercation... between a woma-... and a- ...dier...
Solidarity of Steel#262.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#263.src: Calm yourself, Jiro. Take a breath, and repeat
Solidarity of Steel#263.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#264.src: A woman is being kicked out... again! I don't know the details, but I think she didn't reach her quota for the month.
Solidarity of Steel#264.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#266.src: Living Block {~} - through the southwestern tunnel.
Solidarity of Steel#266.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#270.src: We're heading out. Rescue mission. Yuman, where's Yulie?
Solidarity of Steel#270.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#271.src: He has a meeting in the city today, remember? He told all of us this morning.
Solidarity of Steel#271.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#272.src: ...Right. Right, he did say- alright. We'll have to go in blind, then. Not ideal, but it can't be helped-
Solidarity of Steel#272.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#273.src: Damn it! Not now, of all times to-
Solidarity of Steel#273.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#274.src: What's going on? Is something wrong?
Solidarity of Steel#274.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#275.src: No, no, nothing's- it's nothing bad... I hope. I just need to... check what triggered the alarm. Ugh, can anything go right today...
Solidarity of Steel#275.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#276.src: Hey, bro, don't worry about it. I'll handle it! You take care of whatever you need to, 'kay?
Solidarity of Steel#276.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#277.src: ...Okay. Okay, thanks, Yuman. I owe you one.
Solidarity of Steel#277.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#278.src: Hey, one of these days I'll collect on all those ones you owe me! Don't think you can dodge that just cause you're my bro!
Solidarity of Steel#278.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#279.src: Will you n- ne- need help? {u} and I can join if y- if you need us.
Solidarity of Steel#279.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#280.src: Was just about to ask the same thing! Jiro, Zeph, {u}, you all listen to my orders 'till this is sorted! Got it?
Solidarity of Steel#280.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#282.src: You forgot the "sir" at the end, there! Anyway, let me grab my guitar, and let's head out!
Solidarity of Steel#282.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#284.src: Don't ask, you'll find out later. We need to get moving now.
Solidarity of Steel#284.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#286.src: Follow Yuman to the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#288.src: I hope Yuman doesn't annoy them to death...
Solidarity of Steel#288.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#289.src: Th- through here! Yuman and Jiro are s- sc- scouting up ahead.
Solidarity of Steel#289.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#290.src: Find the woman in trouble at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#291.src: I see them up a- a- ahead... Let's join up with them. Fo- follow me!
Solidarity of Steel#291.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#293.src: Alright, lady! Time's up! It's time to get going.
Solidarity of Steel#293.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#294.src: We need to clean up this filthy apartment of yours for whoever's next in line. We've got a tight schedule, so don't make this harder than it needs to be, alright?
Solidarity of Steel#294.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#295.src: W-w-wait! I still need to pack! You haven't given me enough time!
Solidarity of Steel#295.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#296.src: You received an eviction notice last night, detailing the protocol, didn't you? You've had plenty of time already, lady.
Solidarity of Steel#296.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#297.src: Unless what you mean to say is you take issue with the system? We've got a formal complaints department, lady, but I don't think you'd enjoy paying them a visit.
Solidarity of Steel#297.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#298.src: N-n-no! No, it- it's fine! I-I-I just- I'm just saying th-that- I just need a couple of minutes... Please!
Solidarity of Steel#298.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#299.src: Sigh. I did warn you, lady. Guess we're doing things the hard way, then.
Solidarity of Steel#299.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#301.src: I'm sorry! I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm-
Solidarity of Steel#301.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#302.src: Disrespecting the crown is a serious crime, y'know. Alright, boys, you know what to do.
Solidarity of Steel#302.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#303.src: Hey! We n- ne- need to hel- help her!
Solidarity of Steel#303.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#304.src: Quiet! It's not protocol, we need to wait until the coast's clear, or else-
Solidarity of Steel#304.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#305.src: But th- they're going to beat her! We c- can- we c- can't just let that-
Solidarity of Steel#305.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#306.src: You're new here, so you get a pass for not knowing, but we cannot draw attention towards us.
Solidarity of Steel#306.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#307.src: Yeah, man! If the guards get a whiff of what we're doing, we're toast! The only reason we have the station is 'cause they don't know about it!
Solidarity of Steel#307.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#309.src: M- m- maybe hiding is enough f- f- for you, but I c- ca- can't just let someone get h- hur- hurt!
Solidarity of Steel#309.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#310.src: S- so-... so sc- screw your cover! She n- n- needs help, so I- I'm going to h- he- help!
Solidarity of Steel#310.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#311.src: Hey, don't!-... Damn it. Man, how am I gonna explain this to...
Solidarity of Steel#311.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#312.src: Defeat the soldiers attacking the woman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#313.src: Fine, man! Can't just let you fight alone, can we? Let's just get this over with...
Solidarity of Steel#313.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#315.src: ..Okay. I th- th- I think the coast is clear. She sh- sh- should be-
Solidarity of Steel#315.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#316.src: What the hell was that? What were you thinking?!
Solidarity of Steel#316.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#318.src: No, I really think I should-
Solidarity of Steel#318.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#319.src: Jiro. We've got other things to worry about, man. Cool it till we're back at the station, 'kay?
Solidarity of Steel#319.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#322.src: Wh- who are you people? What are- what are you doing here?
Solidarity of Steel#322.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#323.src: You don't know us, and we don't know you. But we're here to help. I'm Yuman, and these are-
Solidarity of Steel#323.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#324.src: Why... why would you... help me...?
Solidarity of Steel#324.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#325.src: 'Cause... that's what people like us should do.
Solidarity of Steel#325.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#326.src: No! N-n-no... people like us should just do as we're told and not get involved in things that aren't ours!
Solidarity of Steel#326.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#328.src: If I just follow orders, at least I'll survive! I might lose my apartment, and maybe everything I've built for myself, and all the things I've managed to keep for myself, but- but- but at least I'll be alive!
Solidarity of Steel#328.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#329.src: ...I hear you. Trust me, Aihan, I really do.
Solidarity of Steel#329.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#330.src: Can I tell you a story?
Solidarity of Steel#330.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#332.src: Long, long ago, when I was just a little kid, I lost my ma. Dad's out of the picture, so... my bros had to put in the work to take care of me, even though they were just kids too.
Solidarity of Steel#332.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#333.src: But, y'know, being kids... they couldn't do enough. Failed to meet their quotas, just like you. Got kicked out, had to live on the streets.
Solidarity of Steel#333.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#334.src: You want to know the reason we made it through that? It was 'cause someone reached out a helping hand. Gave us a place to stay, to work without the threat of not meeting expectations. To live, man.
Solidarity of Steel#334.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#335.src: So... please. Accept the hand that's offered to you, 'kay? You can come with us and talk to the boss, and if what we have isn't enough for you... no one will force you to stay. But give it a try, please?
Solidarity of Steel#335.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#337.src: Not to ruin the moment, Yuman, but we've got more soldiers coming our way! We've got to get moving soon!
Solidarity of Steel#337.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#338.src: Damn... alright. Aihan, will you trust me?
Solidarity of Steel#338.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#340.src: Okay... okay. Thank you. {u}, could you help her pack her stuff? Zeph, Jiro, help me prepare an escape route.
Solidarity of Steel#340.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#341.src: W-wait! I... I don't know what I'm packing!
Solidarity of Steel#341.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#342.src: Right. Uh... don't bring anything heavy. We have food and cookware where we're going...
Solidarity of Steel#342.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#343.src: Bring something to with, something that ... and maybe some form of , if you've got any.
Solidarity of Steel#343.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#345.src: I... I can't think straight... this is all moving so fast... please- please, can you help me?
Solidarity of Steel#345.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#347.src: Grab that and... pick whatever you think works...
Solidarity of Steel#347.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#348.src: We have to hurry but I just can't think!
Solidarity of Steel#348.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#349.src: Pack something to help Aihan some form of a piece of and something to

Solidarity of Steel#350.src: {u}, h- h- hurry! We don't have m- mu- much time!
Solidarity of Steel#350.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#352.src: Where- where are you going? D-d-don't leave me here!
Solidarity of Steel#352.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#353.src: Did you get everything? Can we go?
Solidarity of Steel#353.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#354.src: Okay... No one's here yet. Let's go!
Solidarity of Steel#354.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#356.src: We're out of time, we have to get moving! Come on, come on!
Solidarity of Steel#356.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#357.src: Up the ladder, into the tunnel! Go, go, go!
Solidarity of Steel#357.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#358.src: Yuman... c- co- come on. Let's go.
Solidarity of Steel#358.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#361.src: Man... that was a really stupid thing for you to do. Like, astronomically stupid, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#361.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#363.src: But I get it. I get it, y'know? If I didn't have to be a leader there, I'd've probably done the same thing!
Solidarity of Steel#363.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#364.src: Difference is, my bros can hold me back from that impulse. Guess I wasn't able to do that, here...
Solidarity of Steel#364.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#365.src: Hate to disappoint 'em, y'know? Bit late now, though. What's done is done, can't take it back.
Solidarity of Steel#365.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#366.src: It'll be alright. Worse things've happened. Aihan's safe, that's all that matters! We'll deal with the rest as it comes.
Solidarity of Steel#366.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#367.src: I- I should've... I should've l-lis- listened to you. But, s- s- seeing the way they- they were treating her... I was j- j- just so... angry. How dare th- they look down on p- p- people like that?!
Solidarity of Steel#367.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#368.src: Yeah... I hear you. Hear you loud and clear. It's not right, is it? But that's what we're working to fix down here, man. Gotta do what little you can, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#368.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#369.src: Let's get going. They'll be expecting us. Wouldn't want to keep 'em waiting.
Solidarity of Steel#369.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#370.src: ...We should f- f- follow them in.
Solidarity of Steel#370.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#371.src: Head back to the Steel Feather through the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#372.src: Report what happened to The Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#374.src: Would- w- would it be weird to say it's a r- r- relief to find out he has a ser- a- a serious side to him?
Solidarity of Steel#374.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#375.src: Not- n- not that this is how I'd have w- w- wanted to find out...
Solidarity of Steel#375.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#377.src: Jiro and I got her settled. Quill's giving her the rundown as we speak.
Solidarity of Steel#377.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#378.src: You should... probably avoid Jiro for now, yeah? He's not exactly... happy.
Solidarity of Steel#378.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#379.src: Right... Got it. So- s- so... how does it wor- work now? Should we re- record this mission s- somewhere?
Solidarity of Steel#379.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#380.src: Yep, yep! Normally I'd go to Quill, but he's busy. Let's see if we can find Yusanu first- he'll... understand. Probably. More than Yulie, at least. I trust him to keep it quiet for now, at least... y'know?
Solidarity of Steel#380.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#382.src: Yuman, I swear. Yusanu should know better than to let you take the lead on these sorts of things! What were you thinking?
Solidarity of Steel#382.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#383.src: Woah, woah, woah! That's a lot of accusations out of nowhere, bro! What gives?
Solidarity of Steel#383.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#384.src: What gives? You know what gives- a whole squadron of housing enforcers turns up dead on the job, and you expect that to go over quietly?
Solidarity of Steel#384.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#385.src: Ahhh. That. Well, you know how it is. Things happen, right?
Solidarity of Steel#385.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#386.src: You-... at least pretend to take this seriously, would you? Of all people, you should know what this is going to lead to.
Solidarity of Steel#386.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#387.src: It- it was- was- it wasn't his f- f- fault, I-
Solidarity of Steel#387.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#388.src: Hey, princess, it's alright. Don't need you to cover for me, 'kay?
Solidarity of Steel#388.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#389.src: So what's the plan then, Yulie? Meeting to talk about it, as always?
Solidarity of Steel#389.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#390.src: Sigh... as soon as Quill gets Aihan sorted, yes. It shouldn't take long, so everyone's gathered in advance.
Solidarity of Steel#390.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#392.src: Hey! What happened out there? Everyone's acting weird about it.
Solidarity of Steel#392.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#393.src: We ended up f- fight- fighting some soldiers to save the w- w- the woman we went there for...
Solidarity of Steel#393.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#394.src: Huh. Is that all? I thought it'd be way worse.
Solidarity of Steel#394.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#395.src: Yeah... they- th- they're worried about it dr- draw- drawing attention...
Solidarity of Steel#395.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#397.src: Still helping out in the kitchen, preparing for dinner! Worry not, I will catch her up once the meeting concludes.
Solidarity of Steel#397.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#398.src: Ah, hello everybody. Apologies for the delay.
Solidarity of Steel#398.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#400.src: She hasn't quite decided yet, but she has agreed to stay the night. She's in a bad state of mind, the poor woman. Some rest will do her good.
Solidarity of Steel#400.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#401.src: But that leads us well to the reason this meeting was called. The retrieval process went... poorly, I take it?
Solidarity of Steel#401.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#402.src: Poorly is an understatement. The military is on high alert now! Everyone entering or leaving {p} this evening was questioned- if I hadn't used our tunnel, I'd still be stuck in line there!
Solidarity of Steel#402.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#403.src: This is an unmitigated disaster. Yuman, what do you have to say for yourself? You should know better by now, we need to-
Solidarity of Steel#403.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#404.src: H- hey! It- it- it's not- it's n- not his f- f- fault! I'm the- the one who-
Solidarity of Steel#404.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#405.src: Nah, the blame falls on me. I was the leader, so anything that happened is my responsibility. I should've... been more firm about it.
Solidarity of Steel#405.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#406.src: None of this would have happened if I'd been there... damn it. The timing couldn't have been worse. This is all my-
Solidarity of Steel#406.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#407.src: Okay, that's enough. You're all acting stupid! Who cares whose fault it was? Either way, it already happened, so let's figure out what we're going to do about it.
Solidarity of Steel#407.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#409.src: And I'm not done! You're all acting like it's the end of the world that some soldiers are dead. So what? Soldiers die all the time.
Solidarity of Steel#409.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#410.src: They don't die like this, though. We don't have the luxury of being able to wave off the crown's attention! If they find out what we're doing down here, we're done for.
Solidarity of Steel#410.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#411.src: But they haven't found out yet, have they? You have options still. For example- you're on the detective force! If suspicions arise, couldn't you just lead them elsewhere?
Solidarity of Steel#411.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#412.src: Besides. If staying hidden means having to look away as innocent people get harmed- what kind of a resistance does that make you? What's the point of any of it?
Solidarity of Steel#412.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#413.src: Rex... take care with your words. Don't say anything you'll-
Solidarity of Steel#413.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#414.src: What's the POINT?! The POINT is all the people we ALREADY have down here who we need to protect! Quill, please, back me up here.
Solidarity of Steel#414.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#415.src: ... No, Yulie, Rex has a point. Even if it was phrased harshly... we have been rather passive in our battle thus far. We've let people get hurt, even if only for the sake of our safety.
Solidarity of Steel#415.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#416.src: We have had our reasons... and we have done good work, to the best of our ability. But if we are afraid to act, how will anything ever change for the better?
Solidarity of Steel#416.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#418.src: You are not wrong to feel frustration, Yulie. I, too, wish this had been handled with more care... but something like this was bound to happen eventually. We will survive this, as we have survived other hardships before.
Solidarity of Steel#418.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#420.src: ...But let's lighten the mood a little! Dinner should almost be ready. Yuman, you told me earlier today you were working on a new song. Would you still like to perform it tonight?
Solidarity of Steel#420.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#421.src: Huh? Oh, yeah, yeah man! I can do that, for sure.
Solidarity of Steel#421.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#422.src: Ahem. Before we depart, if I may- while we are all gathered here, I believe it could be beneficial to lay out some relevant information.
Solidarity of Steel#422.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#423.src: Most of us are new to the Roughworks, so getting to know the lay of the land could help.
Solidarity of Steel#423.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#424.src: Right, of course. I'd been meaning to suggest something similar earlier, before... this situation came up.
Solidarity of Steel#424.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#425.src: Certainly, we could do that! What would you like to know?
Solidarity of Steel#425.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#426.src: Ah, yes. Her name is Soosu. It's hard to say much about her... she's rather reclusive, staying cooped up in her mansion, working away.
Solidarity of Steel#426.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#427.src: She's the opposite of Zhiraok, in that way. Ideally, we'll avoid drawing her attention. We'll have plenty to worry about already without adding her to the list.
Solidarity of Steel#427.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#428.src: That'd be for the best, yeah. She's... kind of a genius. She singlehandedly brought forth the Industrial Age, over a century ago! Most of the machinery you see in Fruma probably traces its origin back to her in some way.
Solidarity of Steel#428.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#429.src: Ha! Yeah, yeah, figures you'd know all that, bro. Nerd.
Solidarity of Steel#429.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#430.src: Wh- that's just written history, Yuman. If you're going to make fun of me, at least do it right.
Solidarity of Steel#430.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#431.src: How about her blessing? If we do run into her, we'll want to know what to watch out for.
Solidarity of Steel#431.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#432.src: I don't know the specifics... but what I do know is that it allows her to mold matter at will. To what extent, or with what limits... hard to say. Still, that uncertainty is dangerous. Be careful.
Solidarity of Steel#432.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#433.src: Very well! Then let us adjourn for dinner.
Solidarity of Steel#433.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#434.src: Speak to Sui at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and watch Yuman's performance.

Solidarity of Steel#435.src: Yuman's performance is about to start. You should grab a bite from Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#435.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#436.src: Oh, {u}! I feel like I've barely seen you around here...
Solidarity of Steel#436.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#437.src: I, um... Mora told me about what happened. On your mission. I'm... glad you were able to help that woman.
Solidarity of Steel#437.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#438.src: I, ha, kind of wish I could've been there, to help. Though, I don't... really know what I could have done, there.
Solidarity of Steel#438.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#439.src: S-so maybe it's a good thing! That I've been, um, busy, cooking. For the Steel Feather. There's, ha, a lot of people here!
Solidarity of Steel#439.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#440.src: But I've been learning new recipes, and getting to know new people! Oh, right, you're probably here for, um, the food. Here! Please have some.
Solidarity of Steel#440.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#441.src: ...oh, hi! Are you here for some food?
Solidarity of Steel#441.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#442.src: Ah, n-no, I- well, yes, I'd love some food, but I'm here to- to thank {u}.
Solidarity of Steel#442.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#443.src: Don't- don't sell youself short! I don't... f-fully understand yet, but, fighting the guards like... like that is dangerous, and- and I know why some people wouldn't want to...
Solidarity of Steel#443.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#444.src: But you did anyway, and- and- and it means a lot.
Solidarity of Steel#444.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#445.src: It, um, sounds like it was a really bad situation. So I'm glad you got out alright.
Solidarity of Steel#445.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#446.src: H-ha... yes. They've been... p-pushy before, but they've never been this- this- this, ah, violent.
Solidarity of Steel#446.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#447.src: Y-yes, I am. It's... new, and- and different, but everyone here has been so kind, and...
Solidarity of Steel#447.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#448.src: It's a little- a little strange... It almost feels like- like- like I don't deserve it! Because, I- I- I haven't... w-worked for it.
Solidarity of Steel#448.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#449.src: Um... I don't really, know, what it's like to live here... but where I'm from, people help each other. You shouldn't have to earn the right to live.
Solidarity of Steel#449.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#450.src: Y-you must be from a much n-nice place than- than here.
Solidarity of Steel#450.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#451.src: Ha... it's kind of ridiculous, looking back. Stupid- s-stupid quotas... ouch...
Solidarity of Steel#451.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#453.src: Oh, it- it's nothing. Just, heavy m-machinery. Hurt my shoulder when- when I went in. It- it's r-really my fault, I, I, I sh-should have been m-more careful...
Solidarity of Steel#453.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#454.src: Um... I- I can, ha, I can help you.
Solidarity of Steel#454.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#456.src: Just... sigh. Follow me, and- and trust me.
Solidarity of Steel#456.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#459.src: H-hey! I- I only have this shirt, I c- I can't- I-
Solidarity of Steel#459.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#462.src: How did- how did you do that?
Solidarity of Steel#462.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#465.src: I-... th-thank you. I didn't... I didn't know cursed ones could be- could be nice.
Solidarity of Steel#465.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#466.src: Um... I sh-should go. Thank you for- for the food, and- and- and for... healing my shoulder. I- I really appreciate it.
Solidarity of Steel#466.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#469.src: It's fine. It's what I expected. I'm... glad I could help.
Solidarity of Steel#469.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#470.src: I- I guess so! Ha... at least she, um, wasn't scared. Just... nervous.
Solidarity of Steel#470.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#471.src: I'll, um, catch up with the rest of you, later.
Solidarity of Steel#471.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#472.src: Go join the others. Uh, I'll join you in a bit.
Solidarity of Steel#472.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#473.src: {u}, it's nice of you to join us. Have you had dinner yet?
Solidarity of Steel#473.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#474.src: It's good, isn't it? Quill tells me she's managed to fit right in with the other cooks here.
Solidarity of Steel#474.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#475.src: So, {u}, are you also w- wait- waiting for Yuman's performance?
Solidarity of Steel#475.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#476.src: I have heard great things about his musical talents! Though, ah, I have also heard this his variety, ah, leaves something to be desired.
Solidarity of Steel#476.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#477.src: Then worry not, for you have been reminded just now, hoho!
Solidarity of Steel#477.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#478.src: Hey, maybe he's written a song about you, Zeph!
Solidarity of Steel#478.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#479.src: Wh- wh- what?! R- Rex, no h- he-... that's n- not-... wh- why would he ev- even-
Solidarity of Steel#479.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#480.src: Ha! Relax, relax, I'm just teasing ya.
Solidarity of Steel#480.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#481.src: Ahem... Attention, attention! Everyone, gather around!
Solidarity of Steel#481.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#482.src: I am heartened to see so many of you joining us for dinner today. It feels as though it has been a while since we've had such a large attendance!
Solidarity of Steel#482.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#483.src: There is of course news to deliver... but first! We begin by thanking our cooks for the meal.
Solidarity of Steel#483.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#484.src: We're all familiar with Fletch's talents, but dinner wouldn't have been possible without the help of one of our new arrivals: Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#484.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#485.src: Oh...! It, ha, it- um. It was nothing. T'was my pleasure! To- to help.
Solidarity of Steel#485.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#486.src: No need to be shy, my dear!
Solidarity of Steel#486.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#487.src: Dinner aside, let's get to the announcements!
Solidarity of Steel#487.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#488.src: Today, we have had not one, but seven new arrivals! In addition to Sui, please welcome Aihan, Mora, Rex, Zeph, {u}, and Syndra!
Solidarity of Steel#488.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#489.src: Now, I'm certain news has spread of our... altercation, shall we say, with the crown's military. I assure you, all is under control! The Steel Feather remains secure and hidden.
Solidarity of Steel#489.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#490.src: It does mean expeditions out of the station will be at higher risk for a time. We will have updated guidelines available in the morning for those of you who volunteer.
Solidarity of Steel#490.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#491.src: But in lighter news, we have restocked candy bars and sodas at the ticket shops! Make sure to trade for some before they run out - remember the rules, one of each per person.
Solidarity of Steel#491.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#492.src: Well then! Barring any surprises at this very moment, that is all for today's report. As he has volunteered himself today, I will hand over the stage to Yuman.
Solidarity of Steel#492.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#493.src: Heeeeeelllllooooo people of the Steel Feather!
Solidarity of Steel#493.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#494.src: Good to see you all as always- ey, Taio, lookin' good! Mei, love what you've done with the hair! Jin, my man!
Solidarity of Steel#494.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#495.src: Ah... I guess I can introduce my song. It's a new one! You guys won't be able to tease me for being an artist with only one song anymore, haha!
Solidarity of Steel#495.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#496.src: I've been working on this one for a while. Never could find a way to end it, though... 'till now, that is. Finally managed to find some inspiration.
Solidarity of Steel#496.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#497.src: Well, enough talking from me. Here it goes!
Solidarity of Steel#497.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#499.src: Hm hm hm! Look who it is!
Solidarity of Steel#499.speaker: ??? (Sovereign Soosu)

Solidarity of Steel#502.src: Happy to see you again, Flowers.
Solidarity of Steel#502.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#504.src: You need to subtract some of this security. It shouldn't need to take twenty minutes to get through just the gate. We need to talk, an hour ago.
Solidarity of Steel#504.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#505.src: Wow, mister loudmouth, big words for someone who wasn't supposed to be here for a few more weeks! What gives?! You're interrupting my flow!
Solidarity of Steel#505.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Solidarity of Steel#506.src: Your sche- Are you taking lessons from Oru? This provincial emergency has a much greater value than your charter, Sovereign, so I'm summing to the equatio- nnh.
Solidarity of Steel#506.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#507.src: I've changed my schedule to come here early and track down a defector- Syndra, and her set of insurgents. You've heard the name, right?
Solidarity of Steel#507.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok
